<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>sn_vulc.TridentClosureUtil</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Closure governance rules for Trident sourced remediation tasks. Evidence validation, governance approval, reopen window checks. Stories SNOWUSEMTP-177 / SNOWUSEMTP-178.</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>TridentClosureUtil</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var TridentClosureUtil = Class.create();
TridentClosureUtil.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
        this.governanceGroup = gs.getProperty('trident.closure.governance_group', '');
        this.tridentSource = gs.getProperty('trident.finding.source', 'Trident');
        this.reopenWindowDays = parseInt(gs.getProperty('trident.reopen.window_days', '30'), 10);
    },

    PENDING_APPROVAL: 100,
    STATE_OPEN: 1,
    STATE_CLOSED: 3,
    STATE_AWAITING_IMPLEMENTATION: 10,

    MSG_NO_EVIDENCE: 'Evidence has not been attached to this remediation task. Please use the paperclip icon to attach relevant evidence before attempting to submit the remediation task for closure.',
    MSG_NEEDS_APPROVAL: 'Trident remediation tasks can only be closed through a governance approval. Use Request Closure to submit the task for review.',

    isTridentTask: function(taskGr) {
        var m2m = new GlideRecord('sn_vulc_m2m_result_result_group');
        m2m.addQuery('group', taskGr.getUniqueValue());
        m2m.addQuery('result.source', this.tridentSource);
        m2m.setLimit(1);
        m2m.query();
        return m2m.hasNext();
    },

    isTridentResult: function(resultGr) {
        return resultGr.getValue('source') == this.tridentSource;
    },

    hasEvidence: function(taskGr) {
        var att = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
        att.addQuery('table_name', taskGr.getTableName());
        att.addQuery('table_sys_id', taskGr.getUniqueValue());
        att.setLimit(1);
        att.query();
        return att.hasNext();
    },

    isGovernanceMember: function(userId) {
        if (!this.governanceGroup)
            return false;
        var gm = new GlideRecord('sys_user_grmember');
        gm.addQuery('group', this.governanceGroup);
        gm.addQuery('user', userId || gs.getUserID());
        gm.setLimit(1);
        gm.query();
        return gm.hasNext();
    },

    requestClosure: function(taskGr) {
        if (taskGr.getValue('state') == this.STATE_CLOSED)
            return 'closed';
        if (taskGr.getValue('substate') == this.PENDING_APPROVAL)
            return 'pending';
        if (!this.hasEvidence(taskGr))
            return 'no_evidence';
        taskGr.setValue('approval', 'not requested');
        taskGr.setValue('substate', this.PENDING_APPROVAL);
        taskGr.work_notes = 'Closure requested for governance review. Evidence attached: ' + this._evidenceNames(taskGr);
        taskGr.update();
        return 'ok';
    },

    closeApproved: function(current, previous) {
        return previous.getValue('substate') == this.PENDING_APPROVAL && current.getValue('approval') == 'approved';
    },

    reopenAllowed: function(gr) {
        var closedAt = gr.getValue('closed_at') || gr.getValue('resolution_dt_tm');
        if (!closedAt)
            return false;
        var cutoff = new GlideDateTime();
        cutoff.addDaysUTC(-this.reopenWindowDays);
        return new GlideDateTime(closedAt).compareTo(cutoff) >= 0;
    },

    _evidenceNames: function(taskGr) {
        var names = [];
        var att = new GlideRecord('sys_attachment');
        att.addQuery('table_name', taskGr.getTableName());
        att.addQuery('table_sys_id', taskGr.getUniqueValue());
        att.query();
        while (att.next())
            names.push(att.getValue('file_name'));
        return names.join(', ');
    },

    type: 'TridentClosureUtil'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-10 12:32:15</sys_created_on><sys_id>7bf8857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba103b</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>TridentClosureUtil</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Configuration Compliance" source="sn_vulc">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configuration Compliance">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7bf8857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba103b</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-20 06:52:38</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_vulc_result_group</collection><condition/><description>When a Trident remediation task with a closure request in flight (Pending Approval) is reopened or otherwise changes state (other than a governed close), the pending governance approvals are cancelled and the Pending Approval reason is cleared so the task can be worked and re-submitted. Reopening is never blocked by this rule.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_vulc_result_group">stateVALCHANGES^EQ<item endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="VALCHANGES" or="false" value=""/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Trident approval cancel on reopen</name><order>80</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    if (!gs.isInteractive())
        return;
    var util = new sn_vulc.TridentClosureUtil();
    if (previous.getValue('substate') != util.PENDING_APPROVAL)
        return;
    if (current.getValue('state') == util.STATE_CLOSED)
        return;
    if (!util.isTridentTask(current))
        return;
    var appr = new GlideRecord('sysapproval_approver');
    appr.addQuery('sysapproval', current.getUniqueValue());
    appr.addQuery('state', 'requested');
    appr.query();
    var cancelled = 0;
    while (appr.next()) {
        appr.setValue('state', 'cancelled');
        appr.comments = 'Approval cancelled: the remediation task was reopened before the governance decision was made.';
        appr.update();
        cancelled++;
    }
    current.setValue('substate', '');
    current.setValue('approval', 'not requested');
    if (cancelled > 0)
        gs.addInfoMessage('The pending governance approval was cancelled because the remediation task was reopened.');
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-20 17:08:18</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0918290093168b90e3aef0aefaba1030</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Trident approval cancel on reopen</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Configuration Compliance" source="sn_vulc">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configuration Compliance">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_0918290093168b90e3aef0aefaba1030</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-20 17:08:18</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=0918290093168b90e3aef0aefaba1030"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_vulc_result_group</collection><condition/><description>Blocks interactive closure of Trident remediation tasks unless evidence is attached and the closure was approved by the governance group. SNOWUSEMTP-177 / SNOWUSEMTP-178.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_vulc_result_group">stateCHANGESTO3^EQ<item display_value="Closed" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="false" value="3"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Trident closure approval gate</name><order>90</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var util = new TridentClosureUtil();
    if (!util.isTridentTask(current))
        return;
    if (!util.hasEvidence(current)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage(util.MSG_NO_EVIDENCE);
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }
    if (!util.closeApproved(current, previous)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage(util.MSG_NEEDS_APPROVAL);
        current.setAbortAction(true);
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-10 12:32:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0c09857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba1073</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Trident closure approval gate</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Configuration Compliance" source="sn_vulc">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configuration Compliance">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_0c09857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba1073</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-10 12:32:16</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=0c09857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba1073"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>false</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_vulc_result_group</collection><condition/><description>Restricts interactive reopening of closed Trident remediation tasks to the configured window after closure.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sn_vulc_result_group">stateCHANGESFROM3^EQ<item display_value="Closed" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESFROM" or="false" value="3"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Trident reopen window</name><order>90</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
    var util = new sn_vulc.TridentClosureUtil();
    if (!util.isTridentTask(current))
        return;
    if (!util.reopenAllowed(previous)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage('Reopening of Trident findings is only allowed up to ' + util.reopenWindowDays + ' days after closure.');
        current.setAbortAction(true);
        return;
    }
    // fresh cycle: a reopened task must not carry the previous approval decision
    current.setValue('approval', 'not requested');
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-10 12:32:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>8009857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba108f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Trident reopen window</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Configuration Compliance" source="sn_vulc">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configuration Compliance">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_8009857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba108f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-21 02:57:08</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=8009857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba108f"/></record_update>

    var util = new sn_vulc.TridentClosureUtil();
    if (!util.isTridentResult(current))
        return;
    if (!util.reopenAllowed(previous)) {
        gs.addErrorMessage('Reopening of Trident findings is only allowed up to ' + util.reopenWindowDays + ' days after closure.');

        return;
    }
    // clear closure stamps so a reopened result no longer shows a close date

        current.setValue('closed_by', '');
    }
})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-10 12:32:16</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>0809857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba10aa</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Trident reopen window (test result)</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Configuration Compliance" source="sn_vulc">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Configuration Compliance">29691e1f0212471dad08668c1e39932b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_0809857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba10aa</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-21 02:57:08</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=0809857c93c2cb10e3aef0aefaba10aa"/></record_update>

Remaining open approvals are marked no longer required so the approval completes as rejected and the closure flow returns the task to Awaiting Implementation.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="sysapproval_approver">stateCHANGESTOrejected^EQ<item display_value="Rejected" endquery="false" field="state" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="CHANGESTO" or="false" value="rejected"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Trident governance rejection policy</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {
